Title: Keep your exam fee
Text: When a student needs a class or study help before the exam, don't send them away. They take our online ServSafe class or the SafePrep study app, and they come back to you for the exam. You don't teach anything, buy anything, or hold any codes.
Price: Students pay us directly: $19.99 for the app, $49.99 for the online class.

Title: A full online course for your students
Text: Our online ServSafe Manager course covers everything ServSafe's own $125 course does, and because it's web-based, it updates automatically and works the way today's students learn. Students take it on their own time, then come back to you for the exam.
Price: Students pay us $49.99 directly. You don't buy or resell anything, and you keep your exam fee.
Link: Reply and I'll send you 7 days of free access so you can see it yourself.

Title: Thinking about becoming an instructor?
Text: If you'd like to add teaching to your proctoring, we'll guide you through the process, and our help is free. As an instructor you can serve every student, including the ones who'd rather learn in a classroom than on their own.

First, add your ServSafe certificate number to your listing, if you haven't already. It's the number after CERTIFICATE NO. on your Instructor/Proctor certificate. It puts a Verified badge on your card and moves you above unverified listings, so students know you're certified. The number itself is never shown.

Title: ⭐ Pro
Text: Everything in Preferred, plus students can pick a class and sign up right from your listing. You get an email with their info, and they get the class details, what to bring, and your payment link.
Price: Intro offer: $14.99 a month (normally $19.99), cancel anytime

Title: ⭐ Preferred
Text: The gold Preferred badge, a highlighted card that stands out from the list, and a top spot when students search near {place}. You show up before every listing that isn't Preferred.
Price: $9.99 a month, or $99.99 a year (two months free). Cancel anytime.

Title: ⭐ Your Exclusive Website
Text: Your own website, built for you and designed to rank for searches like "ServSafe Classes {place}." Students can browse your upcoming classes, register online, see your packages and special offers, and leave reviews, all in one place. It includes Preferred placement on Find a Proctor, and it's yours alone: only one per city.
Price: $49.99 a month, or $499.99 a year (two months free). Cancel anytime.
